Title: WarpSearch for Umbraco Search
Description: Use WarpSearch (https://warpsearch.io/) as the search provider for Umbraco Search. WarpSearch is a fast, affordable serverless search service: your content, media and member indexes live in WarpSearch instead of local Examine (Lucene) indexes, so there is no search cluster to run and no index to rebuild on every web server. Supports full-text relevance tiers, filters, multi-select facets, sorting, culture and segment variants, protected content and the backoffice search tools. Load-balanced sites share one index, and the package runs on WarpSearch's free plan.
